fact_types.title: You check the Credit for other dependents box in row (7) of the Dependents section for this person (Schedule 8812 instructions, i1040s8.txt:90-96). Yes means you claim this person for the credit for other dependents; the person is then a member of the other-dependent relative roster. Contributed categorical assertion, domain {yes, no}, no default, presence-before-value, free supersession.

This person is related to you as listed in Form 1040 Step 4 (son, daughter, stepchild, foster child, sibling, parent, grandparent, aunt, uncle, niece, nephew, in-law, or a step relative), or lived with you all year as a member of your household (i1040gi-2025.txt:1054-1076). Contributed categorical assertion, domain {yes, no}, no default, presence-before-value, free supersession.

No other taxpayer may claim this person as a qualifying child for 2025 (Form 1040 Step 4, who wasn't a qualifying child of any taxpayer, i1040gi-2025.txt:1087-1088). Contributed categorical assertion, domain {yes, no}, no default, presence-before-value, free supersession.

This person's 2025 gross income was less than $5,200 (Form 1040 Step 4, i1040gi-2025.txt:1097). A permanently and totally disabled person whose gross income is $5,200 or more is outside the class: answer no. Contributed categorical assertion, domain {yes, no}, no default, presence-before-value, free supersession.

You provided more than half of this person's 2025 support (Form 1040 Step 4, i1040gi-2025.txt:1106-1107). A multiple support agreement is outside the class: answer no. Contributed categorical assertion, domain {yes, no}, no default, presence-before-value, free supersession.

This person has a social security number, individual taxpayer identification number, or adoption taxpayer identification number issued on or before the due date of your 2025 return, including extensions (Form 1040 Step 5 question 2, i1040gi-2025.txt:1110-1113; Schedule 8812 instructions, i1040s8.txt:56-60). Contributed categorical assertion, domain {yes, no}, no default, presence-before-value, free supersession.

This person was a U.S. citizen, U.S. national, or U.S. resident alien for 2025 (Form 1040 Step 5 question 3, i1040gi-2025.txt:1123-1124; Schedule 8812 instructions, i1040s8.txt:76-78). A resident of Canada or Mexico who is not one of these does not meet this test. Contributed categorical assertion, domain {yes, no}, no default, presence-before-value, free supersession.

This person did not file a joint return for 2025, or filed one only to claim a refund of withheld income tax or estimated tax paid (Form 1040 instructions, married person, i1040gi-2025.txt:1253-1257). A relative who files a joint return is outside the class: answer no. Married filing separately qualifies: answer yes. Contributed categorical assertion, domain {yes, no}, no default, presence-before-value, free supersession.
Closure of the 2025 other-dependent relative roster. Contributed boolean assertion, free supersession.
